Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
Many thanks.

Our letters have crossed but the enclosure was welcome in any way of having it.[^1]
I hope to finish [Abraham](../others.html#177) today and send it

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: A [cheque](../others.html#160) for £200.
